reviews.title: Great motherboard
reviews.comment: Great motherboard. No problems setting it up. The bios and all went great. It will not recognize your drives until you install windows. Which went super fast and easy. Just stick to the M.2 drives. They are awesome!
reviews.author: Marko Pollo

reviews.title: It seems used... but that aside, is a really good motherboard
reviews.comment:
I don't know if it was the shipping or what, but the box has some rashes INSIDE, like if it was peeled or something...
After that, everything looks good, I love the subtle solar system design that it has, and for the price ($100 in my case), I think that its really good value (the vrm heatsinks, the type c connections, the metal protection of the pci-E, etc.)
reviews.author: CassiniA312
